llm_response.reason: The website Soundcore.com.mx displays several scam indicators: the About Us page claims to sell sneakers while the entire website offers electronics (headphones/speakers). This suggests reused, non-tailored content typical of illegitimate, template-scam sites (#4, #5). There is no proper contact information (no address, phone number, only a vague email form) (#6). SSL certificate issues also suggest security risks. While there are no overt urgency tactics or guaranteed money claims, the foundational information is ambiguous, mismatched, and lacks verification—making it highly suspect as a scam site.
